text: Take a slow steady breath in, and let it go.
Let your body settle into the space beneath you.
No pressure.
Just a simple moment to reconnect.
Notice the weight of your body, your feet, your legs, the steady contact with whatever is
supporting you.
With your next inhale, allow your breath to soften your chest.
And with your exhale, feel your mind beginning to quiet, like a gentle dimming of noise inside.
Let your shoulders lower.
Let your jaw soften, let your breath move in an easy rhythm.
Grounding isn't something you force.
It's something that happens when you return to your own presence.
Feel the support beneath you.
Solid, steady, unmoving.
Feel your awareness resting a little deeper in your body.
A little lower, a little quieter.
A little lower, a little lower, a little lower.
With each breath, your mind becomes clearer.
Simpler.
More settled.
A quiet spaciousness opens inside you.
A sense of being here.
A sense of being here fully, gently, steadily.
Take one more slow inhale and let it go.
You are grounded.
You are present and you can carry the steadiness into whatever comes next.
